query:
INSERT INTO news (slug, title, excerpt, coverImageUrl, blocks, categoryId, date, publishedAt, createdAt)
VALUES (
  'utah-shakespeare-festival-2025-season',
  'Assistant Scenic Designer: Utah Shakespeare Festival 2025 Season',
  'Supporting Jo Winiarski''s scenic designs for The Importance of Being Earnest, A Gentleman''s Guide to Love and Murder, and Steel Magnolias at the Utah Shakespeare Festival.',
  'https://files.manuscdn.com/user_upload_by_module/session_file/310519663337866878/OMAcCBOkmTJQReEj.jpg',
  '[{"type":"text","content":"The 2025 season at Utah Shakespeare Festival marks my fifth consecutive summer collaborating with scenic designer Jo Winiarski, providing drafting and 3D modeling support for three distinct productions: Oscar Wilde''s sparkling comedy *The Importance of Being Earnest*, the Tony Award-winning musical *A Gentleman''s Guide to Love and Murder*, and Robert Harling''s beloved Southern drama *Steel Magnolias*."},{"type":"header","content":"The Productions"},{"type":"text","content":"**The Importance of Being Earnest** brings Oscar Wilde''s masterpiece of Victorian wit and social satire to the Festival stage. Jo Winiarski''s scenic design evokes the elegant drawing rooms and garden settings of 1890s England, creating the perfect backdrop for Wilde''s razor-sharp dialogue and mistaken identities.\\n\\n**A Gentleman''s Guide to Love and Murder** follows a distant heir who schemes to eliminate the eight people standing between him and a dukedom. This darkly comic musical requires versatile scenic design to support rapid scene changes and multiple murders, all played for maximum comedic effect. The production showcases Jo Winiarski''s skill in creating flexible theatrical environments that serve both storytelling and spectacle.\\n\\n**Steel Magnolias** transports audiences to Truvy''s beauty salon in small-town Louisiana, where six Southern women gather to share laughter, tears, and unbreakable bonds of friendship. The intimate salon setting becomes a sanctuary where life''s joys and sorrows unfold with warmth and authenticity."},{"type":"image","url":"https://files.manuscdn.com/user_upload_by_module/session_file/310519663337866878/CwvieOMLRmXVfAdv.png","caption":"The Importance of Being Earnest at Utah Shakespeare Festival, 2025. Scenic design by Jo Winiarski. Photo courtesy Utah Shakespeare Festival."},{"type":"image","url":"https://files.manuscdn.com/user_upload_by_module/session_file/310519663337866878/ueblVovAeSyLYljy.jpg","caption":"Steel Magnolias at Utah Shakespeare Festival, 2025. Scenic design by Jo Winiarski. Photo courtesy Utah Shakespeare Festival."},{"type":"header","content":"Five Seasons of Collaboration"},{"type":"text","content":"This season represents a significant milestone—five consecutive summers working with Jo Winiarski at one of America''s premier regional theatres. The 2025 productions demonstrate the breadth of theatrical styles and design challenges that define the Festival experience, from Victorian comedy to contemporary musical theatre to intimate American drama."},{"type":"header","content":"About Utah Shakespeare Festival"},{"type":"text","content":"The Utah Shakespeare Festival in Cedar City is one of the nation''s premier regional theatre companies, recipient of the Tony Award for Outstanding Regional Theatre. The Festival produces eight plays each summer in rotating repertory across three theatres, combining Shakespeare''s works with classic and contemporary plays and musicals."},{"type":"link","url":"https://www.bard.org","label":"Visit Utah Shakespeare Festival"}]',
  90002,
  '2025-10-04',
  '2025-10-04',
  NOW()
)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
  title = VALUES(title),
  excerpt = VALUES(excerpt),
  coverImageUrl = VALUES(coverImageUrl),
  blocks = VALUES(blocks),
  categoryId = VALUES(categoryId),
  date = VALUES(date),
  publishedAt = VALUES(publishedAt);
